title: 2 Air Force pilots eject safely from aircraft near Seguin, JBSA says - KSAT
description: Two pilots safely ejected from their aircraft Thursday “during a controlled bailout” near Seguin, according to a news release from Joint Base San Antonio.

title: Blaze that killed 4 soldiers on Canadian military base sparked on grenade launcher range, officials say - CBS News
description: A blaze that killed four soldiers and injured several dozen more on a military base in the Canadian province of Alberta last week broke out on a grenade launcher range during training exercises, officials said.

title: Ramaswamy’s Ohio attack ad shows ‘owning the libs’ may have limits - The Washington Post
description: The GOP nominee for governor is employing shock-jock politics Republicans have rewarded for a decade. But the latest episode has drawn bipartisan criticism.

title: Hundreds of flights cancelled across East Asia as Typhoon Champi roars toward Taiwan - BBC
description: At least one person has died in Taiwan as Japan, China and South Korea also brace for the powerful storm.
